positive_evidence: Aggressive racing rewards car control, route judgment and managing collisions under pressure.

negative_evidence: The basic racing loop can become repetitive if later events do not add enough new conditions or vehicle development.

positive_evidence: The corrupted-cartoon setting is a highly recognizable horror identity with strong atmosphere and visual character.

negative_evidence: Combat and stealth are comparatively simple, so the experience relies more on atmosphere and mystery than deep mechanical mastery.

positive_evidence: Hidden secrets and multiple outcomes give the escape-room mystery more discovery targets than a single linear puzzle chain.

positive_evidence: Distinct survivors reward learning different movement, attack patterns and combat decisions, creating substantial mastery depth.

negative_evidence: Roguelite repetition can become tiring when repeated early stages stop feeling meaningfully different.

positive_evidence: Large maneuver battles can reward map awareness, careful weapon handling and coordinated team positioning.

positive_evidence: Soaring and gliding make movement itself part of the pleasure, directly matching a durable positive pattern around expressive traversal.

positive_evidence: Turn-based battles emphasize reading enemy intentions and selecting a tactical answer, closely matching the preference for compact plan-test-adjust problems.

negative_evidence: Roguelite resets can still make repeated early encounters tiring if their tactical differences become too slight.

positive_evidence: Different supernatural enemies use distinct survival rules, turning encounters into small pattern-recognition and strategy problems.

positive_evidence: Real-time combat, dodging and weapon use support direct execution skill and visible improvement.

negative_evidence: Procedural runs still repeat foundational rooms and early progression, so variety must remain meaningful to avoid fatigue.

positive_evidence: The intentionally difficult hand controls create a rare form of execution mastery where improvement is immediately visible.

negative_evidence: Deliberately awkward controls can cross from satisfying mastery into frustration, especially when precision failures repeat without new insight.

positive_evidence: A demanding military simulation can offer substantial weapon, movement and tactical mastery.
negative_evidence: Its old-school simulation structure places a heavy burden on learning systems and battlefield procedures, conflicting with the strong negative pattern around overloaded or unclear entry points.

The broad military sandbox offers less of the distinctive story, movement fantasy or rapidly changing mission identity that helped strategy and action games overcome genre friction in the canonical profile.

positive_evidence: Alternating base construction and direct top-down shooting combines tactical planning with active execution.

positive_evidence: Physics-driven fights reward timing, spacing and adapting to unstable situations, giving repeated matches room for execution mastery.

positive_evidence: Action combat and class play offer room for execution skill and learning enemy patterns.
